sections.title: Achievements and responsibilities:
content: Deployed structured cabling, racks, switching and UniFi Wi-Fi in 3 offices with more than 20 workstations each.

Designed, built and released isitmyisp, an open source connectivity monitor for small businesses: 5 releases on Docker Hub (amd64/arm64) with a one-command installer, documentation and a public demo in Spanish and English.
Through my company, BEXCA, I designed and led the network installation of 3 offices, coordinating the technicians I hire per job (4 per project); I built the telecom racks.

As an external consultant, restored a public organization's failed RD Web/RDS access: diagnosed a time drift between Hyper-V VMs and the domain controller (Kerberos) and fixed the domain's NTP hierarchy.
Managed network projects for corporate clients end to end, from site survey to go-live.
I install home servers for private clients with video surveillance on Frigate (open source NVR).

sections.title: Achievements and responsibilities:
content: Operated the FTTH network of more than 50,000 subscribers in 24/7 shifts, keeping availability close to 99% even during the migration to dual stack and dynamic routing, with monitoring in Grafana and Prometheus.
Took part in the design and migration of the network to a minimal infrastructure with IPv4/IPv6 dual stack and dynamic routing (BGP and OSPF).
Led technical meetings in English with international teams and resolved critical incidents in an average of 10 minutes.
Provisioned, troubleshot and activated subscribers on OLTs and ONTs, configuring switches, routers and BGP.
Worked with the Netflix Open Connect (OCA) and Google Global Cache (GGC) content caches hosted in the ISP's data center.
Handled requests in Jira, wrote Bash/Python scripts and maintained runbooks for recurring NOC tasks.

sections.title: Achievements and responsibilities:
content: Led a team of 4 technicians in 14-day rotations, coordinating the handover with the incoming team to ensure service continuity.
Took part in the migration of 1,500 computers and supported about 2,000 people on site, solving hardware, software and network incidents with the local IT team; I also did structured cabling.
Used Microsoft Intune to manage the site's devices: enrollment, configuration profiles and compliance policies.
Managed incident and request tickets in ServiceNow.
Managed user onboarding, offboarding and access permissions on site under the principle of least privilege.

items.company: Agua Potable de Jujuy (public water utility)

sections.title: Achievements and responsibilities:
content: Stabilized an infrastructure that went down every 30 minutes, brought it to 99% availability and strengthened its security; managed 15+ physical and virtual servers and provided L3 support on network and databases.
Supervised a team of 4 and the network of 21 branches; managed contractors for recabling (two buildings with more than 100 users each) and server upgrades.
Cut the connectivity bill by 90%: we replaced a dedicated fiber run with individual connections and moved several links to WireGuard.
Defined the area's policies and quality standards, a disaster recovery plan and a backup plan.
Automated application deployment on merge to main, removing manual infrastructure work.
Deployed corporate and general-use Wi-Fi networks with UniFi, and replaced L2TP with WireGuard to reduce vendor dependency.
Managed the infrastructure area's budget: purchasing, quotes and vendor selection, as well as the area's accounting and payments.
Implemented the IT asset inventory with GLPI.
Deployed on-premise AI services with a local LLM on Ollama.

sections.title: Achievements and responsibilities:
content: Migrated legacy GeneXus systems to Java/Angular, directly affecting billing for 100,000+ residents.
Led the redesign of the institutional website with a mixed team.

sections.title: Achievements and responsibilities:
content: Designed, installed and maintained networks and structured cabling (racks, MikroTik, Cisco, UniFi) for 25+ clients, including work as a contractor for a company in the electrical sector.
Solved interference and performance problems caused by poor cabling, improving connectivity at the sites.
Configured DNS, domains and TLS/SSL certificates for clients.
Built websites for clients (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Bootstrap).
